jobs.title: Engineer - Associate Director
jobs.description:
**Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.****Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.****Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.** **Due to strong performance and continuous growth, we are currently expanding our Engineering Consultancy team and looking for an Associate Director Mechanical Engineer to join our market leading technical asset management team, on a full time permanent basis.** **This role is part of our Engineering Consultancy department who provide a multitude of services across the UK and Europe. The role will be an exciting and diverse one, providing an opportunity to work on a wide range of exciting projects across a number of sectors. Occasionally this will also include asset management and technical due diligence surveys to support CBRE and T\&T’s wider teams.** **With a focus on Commercial projects, the successful candidate will focus on delivering a range of M\&E Engineering Consultancy including Design, Technical Due Diligence, Dilapidations, M\&E Audits, Condition Surveys, PPM/Life Cycle Costing to and range of clients. This role will suit a client facing Associate Mechanical Engineer with technical design skills. The individual must have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written; be a good team player and also able to demonstrate reliability, flexibility and initiative. The candidate must also have the ability to work to deadlines and be able to adapt to ever changing client and market requirements.*** **Provide strategic leadership for Mechanical Engineering services within the Engineering Consultancy business.**
* **Lead and oversee the delivery of Mechanical and MEP consultancy projects across multiple sectors and client portfolios.**
* **Act as Project Director and technical lead on major commissions, making key technical and commercial decisions.**
* **Drive business development activities, identifying opportunities for growth with existing and prospective clients.**
* **Build, maintain, and strengthen senior client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor.**
* **Lead multidisciplinary project teams and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.**
* **Manage project financial performance, resource planning, risk management, and quality assurance processes.**
* **Provide technical governance and review of designs, calculations, reports, specifications, and survey outputs.**
* **Lead technical due diligence commissions, condition surveys, M\&E audits, lifecycle assessments, and asset management projects.**
* **Oversee feasibility studies, refurbishment projects, decarbonisation initiatives, and new\-build developments.**
* **Champion innovation, sustainability, and ESG\-focused engineering solutions including BREEAM, MEES, NABERS, and Net Zero strategies.**
* **Support and mentor engineers across the business, driving technical excellence and professional development.**
* **Contribute to recruitment, succession planning, and talent development within the Engineering Consultancy team.**
* **Represent the business at industry events, networking opportunities, and client engagement activities.**
* **Undertake regular client meetings and site visits across the UK, with occasional travel across Europe.**
* **Support the wider leadership team in delivering business objectives, operational improvements, and strategic initiatives.**
* **Carry out any other duties commensurate with the seniority and scope of the role.**

 **Qualifications*** **Significant experience within Mechanical Building Services Engineering Consultancy, ideally gained within the commercial property sector.**
* **Proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex consultancy projects and multidisciplinary teams.**
* **Strong technical design background combined with experience in asset management, technical due diligence, or surveying.**
* **Demonstrable experience managing client relationships and securing repeat business opportunities.**
* **Strong commercial acumen with experience contributing to business development, fee generation, and project profitability.**
* **Extensive experience using industry\-standard engineering design and analysis software.**
* **Comprehensive understanding of current legislation, regulations, and industry best practice relating to building services engineering.**
* **Experience delivering sustainability and ESG\-focused initiatives including BREEAM, NABERS, MEES, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation strategies.**
* **Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or related discipline.**
* **Chartered Engineer (CEng) status, or demonstrable progression towards Chartered status, strongly preferred.**
* **Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.**
* **Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.**
* **Ability to influence at all levels and build strong relationships both internally and externally.**
* **Commercially aware, proactive, and results\-driven.**
* **Resilient, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities within a dynamic environment.**
* **Confident networker with the ability to represent the business professionally in the marketplace.**
* **Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel as required.**
* **Eligibility to work in the UK.**

 **Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.****We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.****Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.** **Please be advised that effective January 1, 2025, CBRE Project Management and Turner \& Townsend were consolidated into a single global business entity. As a candidate applying for a position, you should be aware that while your initial employment may be with CBRE Project Management, you will subsequently transfer to the newly formed entity that encompasses both organizations.**

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (PHP+React)
jobs.description:
**About SINGU**


At **SINGU**, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become **Europe’s leading platform** for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi\-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 **Our unified CAFM platform** already powers the daily operations of **over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide**, supporting more than **500,000 professionals.** Following our union with the UK’s **Micad** and Germany’s **net\-haus,** we now help manage **100,000\+ buildings** across **35\+ countries** — and we’re just getting started.

  

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as **Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood,** **Logicor, GLP, and Unibail\-Rodamco\-Westfield.** As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: **adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.**

  

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — **join SINGU and be part of this transformation.**

**About SINGU**


SINGU is one of the fastest\-growing PropTech companies in Europe. Our platform manages over **200 million sqm** of commercial real estate for **500\+ clients in 35 countries**, helping property managers digitalize and automate their operations.

**About the Team**


The **TAM (Technical Account Management) team** delivers **customizations, dedicated functionality and system integrations** for our largest enterprise clients \- international leaders such as Prologis, P3, CTP and AmRest.


A significant part of the work is **data imports/exports and integrations with external systems** (ERP, HR, finance, SSO), where **security, data correctness and database performance** are critical. Customizations must fit into a shared, multi\-tenant product \- so design quality matters as much as delivery speed.

**Tech Stack**

* **Backend:** PHP 8 (Phalcon), REST APIs, Redis, background job queues
* **Database:** PostgreSQL
* **Frontend:** React (TypeScript)
* **Tooling:** Git (Git Flow), Docker, CI/CD, PHPUnit, PHPStan
* **AI\-assisted development:** Claude / Cursor / Copilot are part of our daily workflow

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must\-have**

* **5\+ years of commercial PHP** backend development (7\.4\+/8\)
* **Expert PostgreSQL** \- query optimization, indexing, execution plans, migrations on large datasets
* Proven experience designing and maintaining **REST APIs**
* Hands\-on experience with **data import pipelines** and **external system integrations** (files, APIs, queues) \- idempotency, validation, error handling, reprocessing
* **Working React knowledge** \- you can deliver a feature end\-to\-end when needed, not only read the code
* Strong focus on **security** (secure coding, access control, data protection) and **performance** of high\-volume operations
* **Full ownership** of delivered solutions \- from technical design to production and support
* Experience **mentoring** other developers and doing meaningful code reviews
* You actively use **AI tools** (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT) in your daily work
* **Communicative English (B2\+)** \- technical specs, tickets, documentation; occasional calls with client technical teams
* **Fluent Polish** \- the team works in Polish internally

**Nice to Have**

* Phalcon framework
* PostgreSQL tuning (partitioning, vacuum, planner) and performance troubleshooting in production
* ERP / enterprise integrations (SAP, Dynamics, PeopleSoft), SSO (SAML / OIDC)
* Docker, AWS, CI/CD
* Customization\-heavy or multi\-tenant B2B SaaS background
* Improving test automation and local development environments

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and implement **integrations and custom functionality** for enterprise clients
* Build **secure, high\-performance backend services** in PHP, and extend React frontends when the feature needs it
* Design and optimize **data import/export processes** with focus on security, data integrity and performance
* Find and remove performance bottlenecks in application and database layers
* Take part in **technical breakdown and estimation** before development starts; co\-own API contracts
* Review code and **mentor mid\-level developers**; be a go\-to person for backend and database topics
* Collaborate with the Tech Lead, QA, and other SINGU teams (Platform, Core)

**Why This Role**

* Real integrations with enterprise systems \- not toy projects
* Direct impact on systems used daily by some of the largest companies in Europe
* Senior influence: your technical opinion shapes how the team builds
* A team that values clean code, security and performance


If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.


Compensation Range: PLN 18K \- PLN 22K

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Developer
Sodertalje, Stockholm
**Job Summary**
---------------


**Assignment overview:**

**TCS is looking for a Backend Developer to join the Stockholm\-based engineering team. This is a technical developer role and will report directly to the eMSP Technical Lead.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


As one of the engineers in a small, cross\-functional team, you will have genuine influence over technical decisions, architecture, tooling, and how they work day\-to\-day.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Backend Development \& Cloud Infrastructure**

* Design, build, and maintain backend services using modern .NET / C\#.
* Develop and operate containerized services on AWS (primarily ECS/Fargate).
* Build and manage infrastructure as code using Pulumi.
* Develop integrations between internal services and external platforms.
* Contribute to solution design, architecture decisions, and technical planning.
* Improve and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and automated testing.
* Enhance monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting using the LGTM observability stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir).
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


### **Platform \& Charging Experience**

You will shape how TCS packages and delivers a seamless electric charging experience, including data ingestion, aggregation, and classification, for example mapping charging locations to determine accessibility and logistical feasibility for heavy vehicles.


### **Payment \& Billing Infrastructure**

You will contribute to the end\-to\-end payment ecosystem enabling charging across networks and countries, covering:


* Charging cards (physical and digital).
* Card distribution.
* Integration with charging station partners.
* Aggregated invoicing.
* Credit handling.
* VAT compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
* Integration with financial and accounting systems.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

### **Required**

* University degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 2 years of backend development experience.
* Solid experience with modern .NET / C\# (recent versions).
* Hands\-on experience building and operating containerized services in AWS.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, ideally Pulumi, Terraform, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated delivery workflows (e.g. GitLab CI).
* Experience designing and building integrations with third\-party systems and APIs.
* Strong communication skills in English; Swedish is a plus.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with observability tooling and the LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir).
* Experience with OpenTelemetry.
* Background in e\-mobility, eMSP, payment systems, or the EV charging domain.

**Personal Qualities**
----------------------

* Pragmatic and solution\-oriented mindset.
* Trustworthy and relationship\-driven.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative attitude.
* Comfortable working independently with a strong sense of product ownership.
* Structured and self\-driven.
* Entrepreneurial mindset.
#### **Key Areas of the Platform**

* **Charging Network and POI Management**


	+ Ingesting and enriching charging location data.
	+ Maintaining a sanitized dataset suitable for HDV.
	+ Distributing usable location information to downstream consumers.
* **Charging Sessions and Pricing**


	+ Ingesting customer charging sessions from third\-party systems.
	+ Enriching them with contextual data.
	+ Calculating incoming and outgoing costs.
	+ Performing plausibility monitoring to ensure data correctness.
* **Customer Workflows**


	+ Supporting customer data, invoicing and billing flows.
	+ Charging card ordering and integrations.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------

jobs.description:
### **What impact will you make?**

  

  

### **What impact will you make?**


***What Impact will you make?***


**IoT Developer @ Deloitte Competence Center**


Are you looking for an **opportunity** in **Thessaloniki** that offers you a **hybrid working model**?


Are you ready to work on **international projects for industry\-leading clients** around the world and elevate your **tech consulting career** to an **international level**?


If so, check below for more info about this career **opportunity**!


*You bring passion, we bring opportunities!*


**\#YourOpportunity**


Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina \- which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting\-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands\-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.

  

  

Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.

  

  

**\#YourSe****rviceLine**


**Technology \& Transformation**

Our Technology \& Transformation teams empower organizations to navigate the future through technology\-driven business transformation. Combining deep industry knowledge with cutting\-edge technology, we deliver tailored solutions that drive innovation, enhance efficiency, promote cybersecurity, and foster sustainable growth.  



  

**\#AboutYourTeam**


Our IoT practices support our customers in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions in industrial fields and more, identifying and implementing the integration architectures that best meet the requirements and business strategies.


Through our solution architects and developers, we help our customers to create safe and reliable innovations that guarantee a real competitive advantage in the market:


* Our **areas of expertise** offer solutions in the Smart Manufacturing, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT and IoT) and Computer Vision.
* **Graphical interfaces** that offer a high level of usability and scalability on different devices, adhering to well\-defined graphical standards.
* **Integration Services** solutions that aimed at radically transforming operational and digital processes, making them more efficient. Nowadays, a mandatory element for the unison functioning of complex enterprise ecosystems.
* **Technological Architectures** that allow the most modern Cloud applications to be integrated and communicated with "plug \& play" systems with enterprise systems.
* **Micro\-services implementation** that allows orchestration, reuse, and high availability in order to reduce time to market and improve the user experience.
  

  

**\#OurRequirements**
**Key Qualifications**
* Own a degree from a University or Technological Educational Institution in Informatics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar technical course of study
* **0\-3 years** of relevant experience
* Be available to work full\-time with a permanent contract at DACC office in Thessaloniki
* Have a good understanding of the software lifecycle and **problem\-solving skills**
* Have Strong oral and written communication skills in **English**
* Be Proactive and have genuine enthusiasm, curiosity and **\#teamwork** attitude
* Have Programming knowledge:
* + **Object Oriented Programming concepts**
	+ Strong familiarity with **software development and IoT**
	+ Proficiency in at least one of: **C\# (preferred), Java, Python, C\+\+**
	+ Relational databases (one of: **SQLite, PostgreSQL, Ms SQL Server**, etc.)
	+ Experience or strong interest in **IoT architecture** and systems integration
	+ Knowledge of **REST API**, SOAP WS, MQTT, Integration Architectures principles
	+ Knowledge of **.Net** Framework
	+ **CVS: Version Control/Git**
	+ Good Linux knowledge (Ubuntu and/or SUSE)
	+ Basic networking knowledge

**Bonus Qualifications**
* Exposure to **manufacturing projects** or smart factory initiatives will be considered a plus
* Basic **Angular** or other frontend technology knowledge
* Experience with **CI/CD tools** (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab)
* Experience with **AWS** tools (S3, Cloudwatch, Athena, Lambda functions, Stream Manager, Greengrass)
* Basic knowledge of **WebSockets**
* Basic testing and test report preparation experience
* Knowledge of **SOAP WS** protocol
* Knowledge of MES\\MOM products (Siemens Opcenter Foundation, PTC Thingworks\\Kepware)
* Military service obligations fulfilled where applicable
* Enjoy traveling and working abroad
* Italian language
  

  

**\#WhoWeAreLookingFor**


Individuals who have a strong will to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in collaboration with others. We approach our work with a collaborative mindset, teaming across businesses, geographies, and skill sets to deliver tangible, measurable, attributable impact. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.

  

  

**\#WhatWeOffer**


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:


Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working


* Empowered well\-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well\-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)


Engagement within international large\-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.


Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends


Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust


Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work


Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities


A buddy to support you with your onboarding


Extra days of annual leave


* ️ Private medical health insurance plan


Ticket restaurant card


️ Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others


Mobile phone


Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee everyday at our offices


*Please note that all the well\-being benefits mentioned above are subject to annual review*

  

  

**\#AboutDeloitte**


**\#OurServices**


Deloitte offers integrated services that include Audit \& Assurance, Tax and Legal, Strategy\-Risk \& Transactions Advisory, and Technology \& Transformation. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with global business and industry expertise to help our clients excel anywhere in the world. We deliver outstanding impact on the reputation and success of our clients, in Italy and globally. In pursuing this we contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society, and are firm believers in the positive impact business can and should have on the world it operates within.

  

  

**\#OurPurpose**


We are led by a purpose, to make an impact that matters with clients, people and society. This purpose defines who we are and what we stand for. It's not about being the biggest. It’s about being the first choice for the largest and most influential clients, and the first choice for the best talent.

  

  

**\#OurValues**


At Deloitte we foster a collaborative culture where talented individuals can produce their best work. We value innovative thinking, diverse insights and a genuinely distinctive level of customer service through our expertise and professionalism. We value difference, with respect at the heart of our inclusive culture.

  

  

**\#OurTalentExperience**


From day one at our firm, practitioners are part of a community. Our development and career progression framework will help them develop the skills and capabilities to succeed. The wellness of our people and the ability to offer agile working arrangements is at the center of our unique talent experience. We create a workplace that encourages collaboration, creativity, inclusiveness to ensure our staff are supported, encouraged and feel a sense of purpose and meaning in what they do each day.

  

  

**Sounds like the sort of role for you? Apply now.**


**Location: Thessaloniki**
